query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `leads` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(30),
  `email` varchar(320),
  `city` varchar(100),
  `service_interest` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'outro',
  `stage` enum('lead_frio','lead_quente','negociando','fechado','perdido') DEFAULT 'lead_frio' NOT NULL,
  `source` varchar(50) DEFAULT 'importado',
  `notes` text,
  `last_contact` bigint,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
);
